message: `reactive` proxy is not branded for `#n`; calling `read` throws TypeError
help: Proxy at 10:17; `read` at 5:3 reads `#n` at 6:12. Native private fields brand the original instance, not the Vue proxy. Keep `this` as that instance with a constructor-bound method, an arrow field, or `toRaw(proxy)`. Those raw receivers are not observed by Vue when `#n` is assigned.
